messages:
Mina (PM): Heads-up: quick design review on the compact key list + permission scopes modal. Need final copy and a11y checks before next deploy. Meeting notes attached? Jon (Design): Shared updated mock: https://www.figma.com/file/... collapsed row variant, inline scope chip, 'Manage scopes' link. Thoughts? Ava (Product): Love smaller rows but worried about discoverability of rotate/revoke. Maybe show three-dot menu with labels rather than icon-only. Also need hover tooltips. Ravi (DevEx): Shouldn't rotate show a confirmation prompt summarizing affected apps? People are going to accidentally rotate prod keys. Suggest copy: 'Rotating this key will invalidate all active sessions using it. This cannot be undone.' Jon (Design): Agree. Proposed modal copy below: Title: 'Rotate API key' Body: 'Rotating will replace the current key. Any integrations using the old key will stop working. We recommend rotating during low-traffic windows.' Primary CTA: 'Rotate key' Secondary: 'Cancel' Also added aria-describedby -> #rotate-desc Mina (PM): Let's make primary CTA 'Rotate and notify' optional if user has 'notify collaborators' checked. But OOF that adds complexity to API. Maybe leave as 'Rotate key' and add 'Notify collaborators' checkbox in modal. Jon (Design): Accessibility nits: Ensure focus lands on modal title, Escape closes, focus trap, keyboard tabbable for checkbox and CTAs, role='dialog' and aria-modal='true'. Also ensure screen-reader announces change after rotate success: 'Rotation complete. New key displayed once.' Ravi (DevEx): Quick HTML skeleton for the modal (aria hints): ```

Rotate API key

Rotating replaces the current key; integrations using it will stop.

``` Ava (Product): Empty state for keys list: show a big CTA 'Create API key' and a short 1-line copy 'Start by creating a key to authenticate Redwood API requests. Keep it secret.' Add link to best practices doc. Jon (Design): Contrast check: chips currently 2.8:1—fails WCAG. Need 4.5:1 for small text. I'll update palette to darker navy for chips. Mina (PM): Permissions UI: toggle per-scope or 'select all' checkbox. Need to show preview of effective permissions before create. Could be a small summary pill 'Read, Write, Admin'. Ravi (DevEx): Technical: backend supports scope sets. Add checkbox 'Restrict to IP whitelist' in modal; if checked show a small input for CIDR list. Also include server-side validation message sample: 'Invalid CIDR at line 2'. Jon (Design): Also mobile: make rows swipeable? maybe too much. For now ensure responsive: compact rows become stacked on <480px. Mina (PM): Action items: Jon -> update Figma, include a11y checklist; Ravi -> add rotate confirmation server message; Ava -> finalize copy. Ping me when done. Thanks! Ava (Product): :eyes: will review tomorrow.
